-- ASH..-AYE v4 (Block 1: Services & Environment)
shared.ASH = shared.ASH or {}
local ASH = shared.ASH

ASH.Players = game:GetService("Players")
ASH.UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
ASH.RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
ASH.Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
ASH.Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
ASH.TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
ASH.HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
ASH.StarterGui = game:GetService("StarterGui")

ASH.player = ASH.Players.LocalPlayer
ASH.camera = ASH.Workspace.CurrentCamera
ASH.playerGui = ASH.player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
ASH.DISCORD_INVITE = "https://discord.gg/WUaDHv55e"

for _, v in ipairs(ASH.playerGui:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "ASH_AYE_AdminPanel" then v:Destroy() end
end
-- ASH..-AYE v4 (Block 2: ScreenGui Container)
local ASH = shared.ASH

ASH.screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ASH.screenGui.Name = "ASH_AYE_AdminPanel"
ASH.screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
ASH.screenGui.DisplayOrder = 9999
ASH.screenGui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling

pcall(function()
	if syn and syn.protect_gui then syn.protect_gui(ASH.screenGui) end
end)
ASH.screenGui.Parent = ASH.playerGui

ASH.mainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
ASH.mainFrame.Name = "MainFrame"
ASH.mainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0.48, 0)
ASH.mainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.22, 0)
ASH.mainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
ASH.mainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
ASH.mainFrame.Active = true
ASH.mainFrame.Draggable = true
ASH.mainFrame.ZIndex = 100
ASH.mainFrame.Parent = ASH.screenGui

Instance.new("UICorner", ASH.mainFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
-- ASH..-AYE v4 (Block 3: Top Bar & Discord)
local ASH = shared.ASH

ASH.topBar = Instance.new("Frame")
ASH.topBar.Name = "TopBar"
ASH.topBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 36)
ASH.topBar.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(12, 12, 16)

ASH.topBar.ZIndex = 101

Instance.new("UICorner", ASH.topBar).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")

titleLabel.Text = "ASH..-AYE v4 [150 COMMANDS]"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
titleLabel.TextSize = 11

titleLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
titleLabel.ZIndex = 102

ASH.searchBox = Instance.new("TextBox")
ASH.searchBox.Name = "SearchBox"
ASH.searchBox.Size = UDim2.new(0, 180, 0, 24)
ASH.searchBox.Position = UDim2.new(1, -295, 0.5, -12)
ASH.searchBox.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 38)
ASH.searchBox.PlaceholderText = "Search 150 commands..."
ASH.searchBox.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 140)
ASH.searchBox.Text = ""
ASH.searchBox.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ASH.searchBox.TextSize = 11
ASH.searchBox.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
ASH.searchBox.ZIndex = 102
ASH.searchBox.Parent = ASH.topBar

Instance.new("UICorner", ASH.searchBox).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local discordBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
discordBtn.Name = "DiscordButton"
discordBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 70, 0, 24)
discordBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -108, 0.5, -12)
discordBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(88, 101, 242)
discordBtn.Text = "Discord"
discordBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)

discordBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
discordBtn.ZIndex = 102
discordBtn.Parent = ASH.topBar

Instance.new("UICorner", discordBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

discordBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	pcall(function()
		if setclipboard then setclipboard(ASH.DISCORD_INVITE) end
		ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
			Title = "ASH..-AYE Admin",
			Text = "Discord invite copied to clipboard!",
			Duration = 3
		})
	end)
end)

local minimizeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimizeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
minimizeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -32, 0.5, -12)
minimizeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 60)
minimizeBtn.Text = "-"
minimizeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
minimizeBtn.TextSize = 16
minimizeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minimizeBtn.ZIndex = 102
minimizeBtn.Parent = ASH.topBar

Instance.new("UICorner", minimizeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

local minimizedTab = Instance.new("TextButton")
minimizedTab.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 36)
minimizedTab.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.1, 0)
minimizedTab.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(18, 18, 24)
minimizedTab.Text = "ASH..-AYE v4 +"
minimizedTab.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
minimizedTab.TextSize = 12
minimizedTab.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
minimizedTab.Visible = false
minimizedTab.ZIndex = 1000
minimizedTab.Parent = ASH.screenGui

Instance.new("UICorner", minimizedTab).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)

minimizeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ASH.mainFrame.Visible = false
	minimizedTab.Visible = true
end)

minimizedTab.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
	ASH.mainFrame.Visible = true
	minimizedTab.Visible = false
end)
-- ASH..-AYE v4 (Block 4: Tabs & Scrolling Engine)
local ASH = shared.ASH

ASH.tabBar = Instance.new("Frame")
ASH.tabBar.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 26)
ASH.tabBar.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 42)
ASH.tabBar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
ASH.tabBar.ZIndex = 101
ASH.tabBar.Parent = ASH.mainFrame

local tabLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
tabLayout.FillDirection = Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal
tabLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
tabLayout.Parent = ASH.tabBar

ASH.tabContainers = {}
ASH.registeredButtons = {}

local function createTab(tabName)
	local tabBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	tabBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.166, -3, 1, 0)
	tabBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
	tabBtn.Text = tabName
	tabBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 190, 190)
	tabBtn.TextSize = 10
	tabBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	tabBtn.ZIndex = 102
	tabBtn.Parent = ASH.tabBar
	Instance.new("UICorner", tabBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)

	local container = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	container.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -78)
	container.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 72)
	container.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	container.BorderSizePixel = 0
	container.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	container.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 600)
	container.Visible = false
	container.ZIndex = 101
	container.Parent = ASH.mainFrame

	local grid = Instance.new("UIGridLayout")
	grid.CellSize = UDim2.new(0.24, -4, 0, 32)
	grid.CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 4, 0, 4)
	grid.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	grid.Parent = container

	grid:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
		container.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, grid.AbsoluteContentSize.Y + 20)
	end)

	ASH.tabContainers[tabName] = {Button = tabBtn, Container = container, Grid = grid}
	return container
end

ASH.mainTab = createTab("Main")
ASH.moveTab = createTab("Movement")
ASH.visTab = createTab("Visuals")
ASH.utilTab = createTab("Utility")
ASH.funTab = createTab("Fun")
ASH.worldTab = createTab("World")

local function switchTab(selected)
	for name, data in pairs(ASH.tabContainers) do
		if name == selected then
			data.Container.Visible = true
			data.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
			data.Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		else
			data.Container.Visible = false
			data.Button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 42)
			data.Button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 170, 170)
		end
	end
end

for name, data in pairs(ASH.tabContainers) do
	data.Button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() switchTab(name) end)
end

switchTab("Main")

ASH.searchBox:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Text"):Connect(function()
	local query = ASH.searchBox.Text:lower()
	for _, data in ipairs(ASH.registeredButtons) do
		if query == "" or data.Label:lower():find(query) then
			data.Button.Visible = true
		else
			data.Button.Visible = false
		end
	end
end)

function ASH.createButton(parentContainer, name, labelText, order, callback)
	local btn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	btn.Name = name
	btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(36, 36, 50)
	btn.Text = labelText
	btn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
	btn.TextSize = 10
	btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	btn.TextWrapped = true
	btn.LayoutOrder = order
	btn.ZIndex = 105
	btn.Parent = parentContainer
	
	Instance.new("UICorner", btn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
	table.insert(ASH.registeredButtons, {Button = btn, Label = labelText})

	if callback then
		btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			pcall(callback)
		end)
	end
	return btn
end
-- ASH..-AYE v4 (Block 5: Main Tab Part 1)
local ASH = shared.ASH
ASH.isFlying = false
ASH.bodyVelocity, ASH.bodyGyro, ASH.flyConnection = nil, nil, nil

ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnFly", "1. Fly", 1, function()
	ASH.isFlying = not ASH.isFlying
	local character = ASH.player.Character
	if not character then return end
	local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not rootPart or not humanoid then return end

	if ASH.flyConnection then ASH.flyConnection:Disconnect() end
	if ASH.bodyVelocity then ASH.bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
	if ASH.bodyGyro then ASH.bodyGyro:Destroy() end

	if ASH.isFlying then
		humanoid.PlatformStand = true
		ASH.bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
		ASH.bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		ASH.bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)
		ASH.bodyVelocity.Parent = rootPart

		ASH.bodyGyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
		ASH.bodyGyro.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(1e9, 1e9, 1e9)
		ASH.bodyGyro.P = 20000
		ASH.bodyGyro.CFrame = rootPart.CFrame
		ASH.bodyGyro.Parent = rootPart

		ASH.flyConnection = ASH.RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
			if not ASH.isFlying or not character.Parent or not rootPart.Parent then
				if ASH.flyConnection then ASH.flyConnection:Disconnect() end
				if ASH.bodyVelocity then ASH.bodyVelocity:Destroy() end
				if ASH.bodyGyro then ASH.bodyGyro:Destroy() end
				if humanoid then humanoid.PlatformStand = false end
				return
			end
			local speed = ASH.UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) and 100 or 50
			ASH.bodyVelocity.Velocity = humanoid.MoveDirection * speed
			ASH.bodyGyro.CFrame = ASH.camera.CFrame
		end)
	else
		humanoid.PlatformStand = false
	end
end)

-- FULLY WORKING GO TO SYSTEM
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnGoto", "2. Go To", 2, function()
	local oldFrame = ASH.screenGui:FindFirstChild("PlayerSelectorFrame")
	if oldFrame then oldFrame:Destroy() return end

	local selectorFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
	selectorFrame.Name = "PlayerSelectorFrame"
	selectorFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 250, 0, 230)
	selectorFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -125, 0.2, 0)
	selectorFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
	selectorFrame.ZIndex = 500
	selectorFrame.Parent = ASH.screenGui
	Instance.new("UICorner", selectorFrame).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -30, 0, 30)
	title.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Text = "Select Player to Teleport:"
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 65, 65)
	title.TextSize = 12
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	title.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	title.ZIndex = 501
	title.Parent = selectorFrame

	local closeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
	closeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24)
	closeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 5)
	closeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40)
	closeBtn.Text = "X"
	closeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	closeBtn.TextSize = 12
	closeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	closeBtn.ZIndex = 502
	closeBtn.Parent = selectorFrame
	Instance.new("UICorner", closeBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() selectorFrame:Destroy() end)

	local playerScroll = Instance.new("ScrollingFrame")
	playerScroll.Size = UDim2.new(1, -12, 1, -45)
	playerScroll.Position = UDim2.new(0, 6, 0, 38)
	playerScroll.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	playerScroll.ScrollBarThickness = 4
	playerScroll.ZIndex = 501
	playerScroll.Parent = selectorFrame

	local listLayout = Instance.new("UIListLayout")
	listLayout.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
	listLayout.Padding = UDim.new(0, 4)
	listLayout.Parent = playerScroll

	for _, target in ipairs(ASH.Players:GetPlayers()) do
		if target ~= ASH.player then
			local pBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
			pBtn.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 32)
			pBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 50)
			pBtn.Text = "  " .. target.DisplayName .. " (@" .. target.Name .. ")"
			pBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(240, 240, 240)
			pBtn.TextSize = 11
			pBtn.Font = Enum.Font.Gotham
			pBtn.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
			pBtn.ZIndex = 502
			pBtn.Parent = playerScroll
			Instance.new("UICorner", pBtn).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)

			pBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
				selectorFrame:Destroy()
				local myChar = ASH.player.Character
				if myChar and myChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					if target.Character and target.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
						myChar.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = target.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, -3)
						ASH.StarterGui:SetCore("SendNotification", {
							Title = "Teleported",
							Text = "Teleported to " .. target.DisplayName,
							Duration = 2
						})
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end)

ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnSpeed", "3. Speed (2x)", 3, function() local h = ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if h then h.WalkSpeed = h.WalkSpeed == 16 and 60 or 16 end end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnJump", "4. High Jump", 4, function() local h = ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if h then h.JumpPower = h.JumpPower == 50 and 120 or 50 end end)

ASH.noclip = false
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnNoclip", "5. Noclip", 5, function() ASH.noclip = not ASH.noclip end)
ASH.RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
	pcall(function()
		if ASH.noclip and ASH.player.Character then
			for _, part in ipairs(ASH.player.Character:GetDescendants()) do if part:IsA("BasePart") then part.CanCollide = false end end
		end
	end)
end)

ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnFling", "6. Spin Fling", 6, function() local r = ASH.player.Character.HumanoidRootPart local bv = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", r) bv.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(0, math.huge, 0) bv.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 9999, 0) end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnFreeze", "7. Freeze Self", 7, function() local root = ASH.player.Character and ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if root then root.Anchored = not root.Anchored end end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnGodMode", "8. Anti-Damage", 8, function() local h = ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") if h then h.Health = h.MaxHealth end end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnAnchor", "9. Anchor Root", 9, function() local root = ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") if root then root.Anchored = not root.Anchored end end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnKill", "10. Reset Self", 10, function() ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Health = 0 end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnBring", "11. Infinite Yield", 11, function() loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EdgeIY/infiniteyield/master/source"))() end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnUnfly", "12. Stop Fly", 12, function() ASH.isFlying = false if ASH.flyConnection then ASH.flyConnection:Disconnect() end end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnSit", "13. Force Sit", 13, function() ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid").Sit = true end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnLay", "14. Lay Down", 14, function() ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnStand", "15. Stand Up", 15, function() ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnSpin", "16. Torso Spin", 16, function() local r = ASH.player.Character.HumanoidRootPart local bv = Instance.new("BodyAngularVelocity", r) bv.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 20, 0) end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnUnspin", "17. Stop Spin", 17, function() local r = ASH.player.Character.HumanoidRootPart for _,v in ipairs(r:GetChildren()) do if v:IsA("BodyAngularVelocity") then v:Destroy() end end end)
ASH.createButton(ASH.mainTab, "BtnRespawn", "18. Fast Respawn", 18, function() ASH.player.Character:ClearAllChildren() local n = Instance.new("Model") ASH.player.Character = n end)
-- ASH..-AYE v4 (Block 6: Movement Tab)
local ASH = shared.ASH

ASH.infJumpActive = false
ASH.createButton(ASH.moveTab, "BtnInfJump", "19. Inf Jump", 1, function() ASH.infJumpActive = not ASH.infJumpActive end)
ASH.UserInputService.JumpRequest:Connect(function()
	pcall(function()
		if ASH.infJumpActive and ASH.player.Character and ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then
			ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end
	end)
end)

ASH.createButton(ASH.moveTab, "BtnClickTP", "20. Click TP", 2, function()
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool", ASH.player.Backpack)
	tool.Name = "Click TP"
	tool.RequiresHandle = false
	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		local mouse = ASH.player:GetMouse()
		if mouse.Hit then ASH.player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = mouse.Hit * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0) end
	end)
end)

ASH.createButton(ASH.moveTab, "BtnFloat", "21. Air Float", 3, function() local p = Instance.new("Part", ASH.Workspace) p.Size = Vector3.new(6, 1, 6) p.Anchored = true p.Position = ASH.player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position - Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0) end)

ASH.createButton(ASH.moveTab, "BtnSwim", "23. Air Swim", 5, function() ASH.player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"):ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Swimming) end)

ASH.isInvisible = false
ASH.createButton(ASH.visTab, "BtnTornado", "44. Blue Aura", 1, function()
	local highlight = Instance.new("Highlight", ASH.player.Character)
	highlight.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(0, 150, 255)

			part.Name = name
			part.Size = size
			part.Color = blackColor
			part.Material = plasticMat
			part.CanCollide = false
			part.Anchored = true
			part.Parent = shadowModel
			return part
		end

		local torso = createLimb("Torso", Vector3.new(2, 2, 1))
		local head = createLimb("Head", Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2))
		local leftArm = createLimb("Left Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local rightArm = createLimb("Right Arm", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))
		local leftLeg = createLimb("Left Leg", Vector3.new(1, 2, 1))

		eye2.Parent = shadowModel

		ASH.shadowModel = shadowModel

		local function updateR6CFrame(centerCFrame)
			torso.CFrame = centerCFrame
			head.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
			leftArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-1.5, 0, 0)
			rightArm.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(1.5, 0, 0)
			leftLeg.CFrame = centerCFrame * CFrame.new(-0.5, -2, 0)

						local nextCFrame = CFrame.new(newPos, targetPos)

						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)

		if ASH.shadowModel then ASH.shadowModel:Destroy() end

		local customAtmos = ASH.Lighting:FindFirstChild("ASH_DarkAtmosphere")
		if customAtmos then customAtmos:Destroy() end

		ASH.Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = ASH.fogBackup.OutdoorAmbient or Color3.fromRGB(128, 128, 128)
